maya: Quick idea — want to try a small experiment for console backpressure when route quotas hit soft limits. Instead of a hard disable we show a temporary override panel with TTL + telemetry gating. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
rohan: I like that. Need to be careful with audit trail and who can trigger override. TTL should be short (5m?) and require an operator ack. :eyes:
kevin: Agreed on TTL. Also we need to emit an event metric so SRE can track override churn. Suggest names: `config.override.requested`, `config.override.applied`, `config.override.revoked`.
aditya: From API surface: we could add `POST /v1/admin/overrides` with body `{route_id, duration_seconds, reason, actor}` and return an `override_id`. TTL enforced server-side. Sample payload: ```json
{"route_id":"priority:low-latency","duration_seconds":300,"reason":"canary traffic spike","actor":"maya"}```
maya: Nice. UX: show percent of quota consumed + predicted time to exhaustion, and a banner "temporary override active — will auto-expire" with revoke button. Button should call the same API to revoke: `DELETE /v1/admin/overrides/{override_id}`.
rohan: Telemetry gating — we should only surface overrides to product analysts if they include a linked runbook id or tag, otherwise we log but don't show in critical dashboards. Also sample the reason text (P0/P1 classification) to avoid PII.
kevin: Also add a boolean `is_emergency` flag that bypasses normal approval for oncall. But log-correlate to oncall id and require retrospective audit.
aditya: Implementation note: store overrides in Redis with TTL, and replicate to primary DB for audit. Need idempotency key for apply to avoid dupes if console retries.
opsbot: deploy-bot: staging deploy of `override-api` landed at 2024-08-15T14:03:10Z — route-test enabled. :white_check_mark:
maya: Rollout plan: 1) feature-flag gate in console for 5% of orgs; 2) enable API endpoints for internal-only with verbose telemetry; 3) enable UI for ops teams; 4) expand to more orgs after 2 days of no unexpected revokes.
rohan: For metrics: emit counters + histograms for apply latency, revoke latency, TTL expirations. Also tag by `route_family` and `org_id` and a `safety_status` label (auto, manual, emergency).
kevin: Dashboard: a small panel under quota dashboard showing active overrides, who applied them, TTL left. Add an alert if >3 active overrides for same route in 10m.
aditya: Security: require `admin:overrides` scope and mTLS for private deployments. For Hosted, require SSO group check.
maya: UX question — should console warn users trying to apply override that this will change routing behavior and may increase cost? We should show cost delta estimate.
rohan: Yes. Show estimate and require toggle `I understand cost impact` for non-ops users.
kevin: One more: add a telemetry proofpoint event when override auto-expires with reason "ttl_expired" so we can detect if overrides mask underlying capacity issues.
aditya: Implementation TODOs I can pick up: API schema PR, Redis TTL sync, idempotency, telemetry event docs.
maya: Great. Who wants to review API PR?
aditya: I'll open a draft in an hour and tag you all.
rohan: I'll mock the console UX and attach screenshots.
kevin: I'll sketch dashboard panels and alert rules.
maya: Thanks — tagging for followups @here. :thumbsup:
opsbot: incident-bot: note — no incidents related to overrides in last 7 days.
